cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Compare line counts
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("wc -l /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("VPS lines:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check if there's a specific issue with line 1449 context - look at function above it  
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '1380,1410p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("\nFunction start:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
